Recast the ability to spin towards your weapon, dealing <color=#E6E6E6>{spindamage}</color> physical damage to enemies in your path. This action will cancel recall.

AB_Vampire_TwinBlades_SweepingStrike_Abi.tooltipTextEn: Lunge forward and swing your twinblade dealing <color=#E6E6E6>{damage}</color> physical damage in a line and launching enemies into the air and to the opposite side of you.

AB_Vampire_VeilOfBlood_Group.tooltipTextEn: Dash towards input direction and elude nearby enemies for <color=#E6E6E6>{duration}s</color>. Your next primary attack heals you for <color=#E6E6E6>{healing}</color> of your maximum health and triggers a nova of blood that deals <color=#E6E6E6>{novadamage}</color> magic damage, drains <color=#E6E6E6>{noveleech}</color> health and inflicts <color=#C52443>Leech</color>.

AB_Vampire_VeilOfBones_AbilityGroup.tooltipTextEn: Dash towards input direction and elude nearby enemies for <color=#E6E6E6>{duration}s</color>. Your next primary attack heals you for <color=#E6E6E6>{healing}</color> of your maximum health, inflicts <color=#4ddb00>Condemn</color> and <color=#E6E6E6>summons a skeleton warrior</color>.

AB_Vampire_VeilOfChaos_Group.tooltipTextEn: Dash towards input direction and elude nearby enemies for <color=#E6E6E6>{duration}s</color>. Your next primary attack heals you for <color=#E6E6E6>{healing}</color> of your maximum health, inflicts <color=#e25dff>Ignite</color> and allows you to <color=#E6E6E6>recast</color> the ability to dash once more. Your illusion explode, dealing <color=#E6E6E6>{damage2}</color> magic damage to nearby enemies and inflicting <color=#e25dff>Ignite</color> when the effect ends.

AB_Vampire_VeilOfChaos_Recast_Group.tooltipTextEn: Dash towards input direction and elude nearby enemies for <color=#E6E6E6>{duration}s</color>. AB_Vampire_VeilOfFrost_Group.tooltipTextEn: Dash towards input direction and elude nearby enemies for <color=#E6E6E6>{duration}s</color>. Your next primary attack heals you for <color=#E6E6E6>{healing}</color> of your maximum health, shields you for <color=#E6E6E6>{shield}</color> of your spell power and inflicts <color=#03a3ff>Chill</color>.

AB_Vampire_VeilOfIllusion_AbilityGroup.tooltipTextEn: Dash towards input direction and elude nearby enemies for <color=#E6E6E6>{duration}s</color>. Your next primary attack heals you for <color=#E6E6E6>{healing}</color> of your maximum health and inflicts <color=#37dfb9>Weaken</color>. <color=#E6E6E6>Recast</color> to return to your start position.

AB_Vampire_VeilOfIllusion_Recast_Ability.tooltipTextEn: Detonate your illusion dealing <color=#E6E6E6>{damage}%</color> damage and inflicting <color=#37dfb9>weaken</color> in an area on recast.

AB_Vampire_VeilOfShadow_Group.tooltipTextEn: Dash towards input direction and elude nearby enemies for <color=#E6E6E6>{duration}s</color>. Your next primary attack deals <color=#E6E6E6>{damage}</color> bonus damage and heals you for <color=#E6E6E6>{healing}</color> of your maximum health.

AB_Vampire_VeilOfStorm_Group.tooltipTextEn: Dash towards input direction and elude nearby enemies for <color=#E6E6E6>{duration}s</color>. Gain <color=#E6E6E6>{attackrate}</color> increased attack speed for <color=#E6E6E6>{attackrateduration}s</color>. Your next primary attack heals you for <color=#E6E6E6>{healing}</color> of your maximum health and inflicts <color=#fdff5d>Static</color>.

AB_Vampire_Whip_Dash_AbilityGroup.tooltipTextEn: Leap towards the cursor and swing your whip around you dealing <color=#E6E6E6>{damage}</color> physical damage, knocking enemies back and inflicting a <color=#E6E6E6>{duration}s</color> fading snare.

AB_Vampire_Whip_Entangle_AbilityGroup.tooltipTextEn: Strike in a line dealing <color=#E6E6E6>{linedamage}</color> physical damage and inflicting a <color=#E6E6E6>{lineduration}s</color> entangle.

AB_Vampire_Whip_Primary_AbilityGroup.tooltipTextEn: Perform a combo of melee attacks dealing <color=#E6E6E6>{tipdamage1}</color>/<color=#E6E6E6>{tipdamage2}</color>/<color=#E6E6E6>{tipdamage3}</color> physical damage to enemies in a line. AB_Vampire_Whip_Primary_Mounted_AbilityG.tooltipTextEn: Attack from your mount dealing <color=#E6E6E6>{damage}</color> physical damage to the first enemy hit. Deals <color=#E6E6E6>{splashdamage}</color> additional physical damage in a small radius at the tip of the whip.
